summary: Settings uses setup’s theme thumbnails and motion choices, with a live paper-setting sample in Writer. The full preview stays in reach on narrow screens. Settings → Course pages → Speed groups instant pages, course-data prefetch and loading feedback; Score bars live with Grades. School and setup are directly accessible, and Settings → Privacy and data → School links to connection settings. Existing section addresses and advanced controls remain available. Typing / in a key or passphrase no longer opens Settings search. Frost is available as a complete theme in Settings. The separate palette-only reset is labelled Reset palette. Search and paper-format controls follow their parent features without losing saved preferences. Blackboard Activity cards follow their course’s color, including cards reused while scrolling. Blackboard organization quizzes use the sidebar’s assessment layout and keep editor menus within reach. Grade tabs share one rounded surface.
